ctx.x: You’re old enough to be my brother.
There you go. But I remember being turned on to pop music, like Little Eva and “The Locomotion” and that kind of stuff that was on AM radio. Did that stuff make an impression on you?

Some of the pop stuff I discovered later It wasn’t like I was against it, and I can’t remember what instrument — and of course the Beatles were all around. I didn’t get the Beatles as much as I did later. But I don’t know, that’s a good question, because I can’t quite remember what really turned me on back then. I mean we listened to as much jazz as we could. But wide open. Like for instance, we lived in Fairfield, Connecticut, that’s where I lived, who’s we, I don’t — and there was a radio station in Baltimore —…
